hero.subheadline: Watercolor artists worldwide compete for cash prizes and publication
hero.valueProposition: Winning entries earn up to $2,000 and are published alongside an in-depth artist profile in The Best of Watercolor (Summer 2027).

content.whyJoin:
Splash has celebrated contemporary watermedia artists since 1991, and Splash 28 is presented by Artists Network and Watercolor Artist magazine. The competition is open to artists around the world aged 18 and above, and it selects over 100 finalists for publication in The Best of Watercolor, a special edition produced by the editors of Artists Magazine and Watercolor Artist.

Beyond the $3,500 in cash prizes, award winners receive a one-year Artists Network Membership valued at $99.99, a digital award-winner badge, and a $50 gift card for honorable mentions. The juror of awards, Bev Jozwiak, holds Signature status in every major watercolor society, and the judges assess entries in two rounds on artistic technique, handling of the medium, design and creative elements, and overall impression.

The contest accepts original two-dimensional work in watercolor or similar water-based media such as gouache, casein, or egg tempera on paper. Entrants can submit unlimited entries and may edit them until the final deadline, which gives artists flexibility to enter their strongest pieces.
content.whoShouldApply:
This contest is for watercolor and watermedia artists of all experience levels, from emerging painters to established professionals, who create original two-dimensional work. It suits artists whose dominant medium is watercolor, gouache, casein, or egg tempera on paper, and who are aged 18 or older.

It is also suited to artists who want publication exposure: the top three winners have their winning entries and an in-depth artist profile published in The Best of Watercolor, and more than 100 finalists are featured in a gallery in the publication.

faq.question: What types of artwork are acceptable?
faq.answer: The dominant medium must be watercolor, with similar water-based media such as gouache, casein, or egg tempera also acceptable as the dominant medium if used on paper. Acrylic paints are not acceptable as the dominant medium. Entries are limited to two-dimensional work no deeper than 1.5 inches, and any other media used must be specified in the application.

faq.question: Is AI-generated artwork allowed?
faq.answer: No. All works must be original and from the hand of a single artist. Artwork or reference imagery generated by artificial intelligence will not be considered, and compositions based on published material or other artists' work are not eligible.

faq.question: What are the entry fees and deadlines?
faq.answer: Fees are tiered by submission date. The Super Early Bird deadline is August 11, 2026, at $15 for members and $25 for non-members. The Early Bird deadline is October 9, 2026, at $25 and $35. The final deadline is December 11, 2026, at $30 and $40. Fees are due with entries.

faq.question: Can an artist submit more than one entry?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no limit to the number of entries you may submit, and you can edit your entries until the final deadline. To officially enter an image into the jurying pool, you must select Submit Entry, which places the entry in your cart for payment.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: First place receives $2,000, second place $1,000, and third place $500. The 10 honorable mention winners receive a $50 gift card and a one-year Artists Network Membership. All award winners receive a digital badge, and winners plus more than 100 finalists are featured in The Best of Watercolor (Summer 2027).

submissionGuide.step: Create an account on the entry portal
submissionGuide.detail: Visit the online entry portal at artistsnetworkcompetitions.awardsplatform.com and log in or register for a free account. Members should use the email associated with their Artists Network membership.

submissionGuide.step: Upload your entry details and image
submissionGuide.detail: Provide your entry details and upload your image or images. Confirm the dominant medium is watercolor or an accepted water-based medium on paper, and specify any additional media used.

submissionGuide.step: Submit and pay your entry fee
submissionGuide.detail: Select Submit Entry to place the entry in your cart, then pay the fee corresponding to your membership status and the submission date. Your record of the credit card or PayPal charge serves as your receipt.
You may save your progress and return at any time, and you can edit your entries until the closing deadline of December 11, 2026.

Entries are judged in two rounds on artistic technique, handling of the medium, design and creative elements, and overall impression. Award winners and finalists are published in The Best of Watercolor in Summer 2027.
